description: Unit tests for the TalkDirectiveParser class, verifying parsing of directives from JSON strings, handling of unknown keys, alternate key parsing, and cases with no directives.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParserTest
classes.description: Test class for TalkDirectiveParser, containing multiple test methods to validate parsing logic.

methods.name: parsesDirectiveAndStripsHeader

methods.name: parsesAlternateKeys
methods.description: Verifies parsing when alternate/directive keys are used.
